rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Static analysis tool that scans codebases for AI framework usage across 16 frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, HuggingFace, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and more) and checks compliance against EU AI Act requirements. Provides risk category classification, compliance scoring against required documentation, actionable remediation recommendations with relevant EU articles, and starter compliance document templates. Also includes GDPR scanning tools for personal data processing compliance.
